name: Michelle Davies
bio:
Michelle's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, after spending her early career in traditional advertising. It wasn't until a chance encounter at a local race event sparked a profound interest. She quickly realized her marketing expertise could be a powerful asset in this exciting world. She brings a unique blend of analytical rigor and creative flair to Walkinshaw Andretti United. 

Michelle excels at crafting comprehensive marketing strategies, always keeping the big picture in mind. She believes in fostering genuine connections with fans and sponsors alike. Her flexible approach allows her to adapt swiftly to the ever-changing landscape of motorsport marketing, ensuring that the team's message resonates effectively across all platforms. She is known for her data-driven decision making coupled with a knack for identifying emerging trends.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair, often pulled back in a practical ponytail during race weekends.
physical.description: Michelle is of average height with a warm smile and an approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a lucky racing die in her pocket during races.
Has a collection of vintage motorsport posters in her office.
Starts every day with a meticulously planned to-do list.
